items.title: Bill Bourgeois Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: Yeah, Angelo Palmasana for a guitar.

ctx.x: Let's see, did we get a guitar player with the Owls?

Yeah, Angelo Palmasana for a guitar. He never did join a union. He just faded out and quit playing gradually and then all the rest of us, I believe we were in the union at the time or just before we joined the union. We played at the old Spanish fort, the opening of the new pavilion, on percentage, commission basis. And the first week we worked we got sixty cents a piece. Good Lord.
